task_completion.description: The agent successfully opens the 'Mitosis' sample dataset in ImageJ.
task_completion.visual_evidence: An ImageJ window titled 'mitosis.tif' or 'mitosis (5D)' showing a 5D hyperstack (channels=2, slices=5, frames=51).

task_completion.description: A Maximum Intensity Z-Projection is performed on the stack.
task_completion.visual_evidence: A new image window appears with 'MAX_' prefix in the title, and the 'slices' dimension in the image info bar is reduced to 1 or removed.

task_completion.description: The Red channel (Channel 1) is isolated and the Green channel is removed.
task_completion.visual_evidence: The image window shows 'C=1/1' or the title indicates channel 1. The image should appear grayscale or red-tinted chromatin, not green spindles.

task_completion.description: A sub-stack containing only the first 20 timepoints is created.
task_completion.visual_evidence: The image info bar at the top of the window shows '1/20' frames instead of the original 51.

task_completion.description: A timestamp is added to the top-left corner with the correct interval and font size.
task_completion.visual_evidence: A 'Time Stamper' dialog box showing 'Interval: 15.00', 'Font size: 20-25', and 'Location: Top-Left'. The resulting image must show a '00:00' (or similar) text overlay in the top-left corner.

task_completion.description: The final processed TIFF stack is saved to the specified directory.
task_completion.visual_evidence: A 'Save As' dialog or a file explorer view showing the file 'mitosis_movie_formatted.tif' being saved to '~/ImageJ_Data/processed/'.

integrity.description: The agent used the ImageJ GUI menus rather than just executing a background script or terminal command.
integrity.visual_evidence: Screenshots show the mouse cursor interacting with ImageJ menus (Image > Stacks, Image > Hyperstacks, etc.) and dialog boxes.

integrity.description: The agent did not simply rename the original file or move a pre-existing file.
integrity.visual_evidence: Sequential screenshots show the intermediate windows (MAX_ projection, Substack, etc.) being generated in real-time.

integrity.description: The agent interacted with the software to determine parameters rather than typing them from memory without looking.
integrity.visual_evidence: The agent opens the 'Properties' or 'Show Info' windows to verify stack dimensions before processing.
